notes.title: YES, THIS IS UPDATE
notes.content:
Current state of the game and plans
Hi! It's almost a year since Force Reboot launched in Early Access. But I still want to work and add new stuff to Force Reboot thanks to u guys! Here's update that I've been working on. Also I wanted to say sorry for not publishing anything new. Part of the reason is that I was working on a demo for my new game called Completely Fictional Story About a City Inside a Whale. It's coming really soon! But for now you can play this new update. 

Major content update is coming later this autumn. I'm planning to add new zone, few enemies, new arena map and hopefully few new tracks. And yes, I still want to add at least one BOSS (Yeap, I know that I already told u that I wanted to add new enemies and arena map in this update, but I still decided to divide two updates just to test new stuff that I added in this update and work a bit more on new content). [spoiler]if you want your tracks to be added in Force Reboot just text about it under this post and I contact with u <3[/spoiler]

Current update:
In this update I tried to fix major problem that I have with a game. And this problem was that players didn't really needed to use movement options like dashes, jumps and slides. 
I completely reworked SPEED MULTIPLIER system. 
In order to gain multiplier you need to combine different movement options and kills. Multiplier won't increase if you constantly spamming one of the options (Like always sliding for example). 

I also tried to add controller support but due to my shitty coding in past it turn out to be problematic. I'm still planning to add it for Full Release but now right now.

Other features:
New stuff:

 Added options to change tracks in different modes
 Added weak points for all enemies
 Added reflection tutorial note
 Added EIN THE FROG (you can find him at the Start)
 Demo Deleted


Buffs and Debuffs:

 Random weapon every room - DEBUFF
 Heal from traps - BUFF
 No weak points - DEBUFF
 Hitting weak points has chance to heal player - BUFF
 Slippy Movement - DEBUFF
 25% chance to automatically reload after kill - BUFF


Reworked:

 Railgun is based on speed multiplier now and it's also 2x time faster
 Fists damage is increased 2x times (I know that it's not fixing Fists but it's least I can do for now)
 Cloud speed at Stage Three is increased
 SMG spread increased
 Camera movement is changed a bit


Fixes:

 Timer is not adding time on pause now 
 No more fps drops after quiting to menu
 Fixed "Faster" achievement (it was 2 minutes not 3)


AND ALSO NEW ACHIEVEMENTS!

Thank you for playing FORCE REBOOT! Love you guys! <3

(Also I'm aware about few bugs like this bug with chance to reaload and double gun but I can't really fix it right now, sorry)

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hi! After the last update, I switched to other projects and have been working on them all this time. I needed a break to get back to Force Reboot and figure out what to do next. 

I'm planning to release a big update in July-August. It will include rebalance of old guns, new weapons, new arena map, skills, controller support and other minor changes. [spoiler]and small frog (hey Ein)[/spoiler] Initially, I planned to make 3 game zones and release the game, but many players wanted more so now I am now actively thinking about a new zone and enemies. Just like last time I am striving to give a different gaming experience from the other zones, and it may take time. 

I have also decided to remove the demo from Steam soon. This version of the game will still remain on the Itch.io page, but in Steam it rather confuses the player because of the strong difference in quality between the demo and the paid version of the game. 

Many players have noted that the game may cost more than the current price at this point, so I will consider a small $1 or $2 price increase after I can assess the scope of the future update. 

In the meantime, you can get Force Reboot with 50% off deal this summer sale!

Thank you for playing Force Reboot! I love u guys <3

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hi! Long time no see!

I was taking a small break from the game since I was working on it alone for more than a year. I didn't want to release bland updates or boring re-skinks of existing weapons or enemies so I decided to take some time and think about third zone and release everything with one big update.

Right now I'm already working on content for the third zone. New weapons(I know I already announced it but turns out it needs way more balancing and changing some stuff in other parts of a game), some useful stuff like restarting a run in any time or headshots (or weak spot if we are talking about drones).
I want the third zone to be really different from the other two so it takes some time.

I'm planning to release the third zone in november-december. I'm really sorry about no updates for more than a month. I hope you understand.
Also I want to clarify that I'm not planning to drop this game before I finish everything that I promised for early access. I'm also still reading every comment on ideas/bug fixes forum or review. So feel free to tell me anything you thought about the game. Thank you for playing my game! It means a lot to me!
